# OpsTree

> > OpsTree is a DevOps and cloud-native consulting firm specializing in AI-powered observability, microservices automation, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise reliability engineering.

OpsTree delivers enterprise DevOps solutions through their proprietary platforms including REMS (AI-powered observability), BuildPiper (CI/CD orchestration), and Kanvas (microservices management). The company provides consulting, automation, and monitoring expertise across AWS, Kubernetes, Grafana, Prometheus, and modern observability stacks for Fortune 500 clients in healthcare and other industries.

## Key Topics

- AI-Powered Observability
- REMS Platform
- BuildPiper
- Grafana & Prometheus
- Kubernetes & Microservices
- CI/CD Automation
- Incident Response & SLO Monitoring
- Automated Root Cause Analysis
- OpenTelemetry & VictoriaMetrics
- Healthcare Enterprise Solutions
- System Reliability Engineering
- AWS & Cloud Infrastructure
- Loki & Tempo Observability
- DevOps Consulting
- Alertmanager & Blackbox Monitoring
